PREAMB.SUBJECT: Cybersecurity Risk Management, Strategy, Governance, and Incident Disclosure

SUM.P: The Commission is adopting amendments to require current disclosure about material cybersecurity incidents.1

EFFDATE.P: Effective date: The amendments are effective September 5, 2023.

SUPLINF.P: A long discussion that the corpus leaves out.2

EXTRACT.HD: B. Events To Be Reported and Time for Filing of Reports
EXTRACT.P: 1. A report pursuant to Item 1.05 is to be filed within four business days after the registrant determines that it has experienced a material cybersecurity incident.
(a) If the registrant experiences a cybersecurity incident that is determined by the registrant to be material, describe the material aspects of the nature, scope, and timing of the incident.
Furnish the information required by Item 106 of Regulation S-K.
